nav.label: View
globe.heading: Common Operating Picture
layers.label: Track layers
plugins.heading: Plugins
admin.themeHint: Edit the JSON theme. primaryColor and bannerLabel drive the classification banner; affiliationColors override the APP-6D palette in the operator view.
admin.terminologyHint: Map platform terms to your terms (e.g. {"plugin":"module"}). Applied client-side across the UI.
admin.selectPrompt: Select a tenant on the left.
admin.error.notObject: Theme/terminology must be a JSON object.
sensors.heading: Sensor Registry
sensors.hint: Bulk-register sensors as a JSON array. Required: external_id, family, display_name.
sensors.error.notArray: Bulk JSON must be an array of objects.
members.heading: Members & Roles
members.hint: Tenant-scoped roles. In the real platform NPKI binding lands in Sprint 10.
bms.heading: Battle Management
bms.hint: Mock threat-prioritisation + weapon-target pairing. WILL is a coordinator: APPROVE gates EXECUTING; the effector reports COMPLETED.
bms.empty.threats: No threats. Use the Inject button or load tracks via the Ops view.
bms.coaHint: Greedy assignment by priority then expected probability of kill. Operator approves; effector executes.
bms.flash.pntDenied: GNSS denied — UAV threats marked DENIED
forces.heading: Friendly Force Tracking
forces.hint: Blue-force picture (ADR-010): NFFI / CoT-friendly / WILL-native ingest. Situational awareness only — friendly assets cannot be targeted.
naval.heading: Naval / Own-Ship
naval.hint: Vessels as mobile nodes (ADR-011). WILL integrates the ship into the federated picture; the vessel's own combat-management system stays authoritative for the vessel's fight.
naval.boundary: WILL coordinates across platforms — it does not run the vessel's combat-management system, task its payloads, or fight the ship. Own-ship effectors register into BMS with the platform so pairing knows they move with the hull.
fires.boundary: AWARENESS ONLY — NOT FIRE CONTROL. WILL ingests fire-support coordination measures and fire-mission STATUS from the authoritative fires C2 for deconfliction. It never creates, tasks, or computes fires (ADR-012).
fires.heading: Fires Coordination
fires.hint: Read-only FSCM + fire-mission status from the authoritative fires C2 (AFATDS-class). One-way: fires C2 → WILL.
fires.missionsNote: Status only — no targeting, no tasking, no solutions. firing_unit is a display label.
fires.deconflictionNote: Advisory only — returns flags; never blocks, gates, or approves anything.
fires.clear: No active measures contain this point.
training.heading: War-Games Training
training.hint: Progression hub (wargame-nexus model) with Lattice-style runs. EXERCISE-isolated — nothing here touches the live picture (ADR-013).
training.leaderboardNote: Best completed score per trainee per scenario (tenant-scoped). Backed by the trainer service in the full platform.
legacy.boundary: BC2A® / ICIS BRIDGE — WILL wraps, it does not rewrite. BC2A is a sensor source; WILL never writes its DB or commands it. Southbound is advisory backwards-compat; the customer ICIS gateway injects, not WILL (ADR-014). Public NATO standards only.
legacy.heading: Legacy C2 Bridge (BC2A® / ICIS)
legacy.hint: Phase-1 Protocol Adapter Layer: JC3IEDM + AdatP-3 in, MIL-STD-2525D + AdatP-3 back out for backwards compatibility.
legacy.northboundNote: Structured NATO records replicated from ICIS — treated as a sensor source.
legacy.normalisedNote: Normalised to the WILL canonical track + APP-6 SIDC + STANAG-4774 marking (never downgraded).
legacy.southboundNote: Rendered for the ICIS gateway to loop into BC2A clients. WILL renders; it does not inject.
